name: Gross Merchandise Value
description: Total merchandise value of included orders before refunds and cancellations are deducted.
default_filters: Use the agreed valid-order status set.
caveats: Confirm whether tax, shipping, discounts, and cancelled orders are included.
source: Google Analytics ecommerce metrics and common commerce reporting practice

name: Payment Gross Merchandise Value
description: Total paid amount associated with the eligible order population.
default_population: Valid paid orders in the analysis period.
caveats: Aggregate multiple payment rows to the order grain before combining payment GMV with order-level metrics.
Payment GMV is not necessarily merchandise GMV, recognized revenue, or net sales.

name: Net Sales
description: Recognized sales after discounts, cancellations, and refunds according to the selected policy.
caveats: Refund timing and partial refunds must be defined explicitly.

name: Gross Profit
description: Revenue remaining after the explicitly defined cost of goods sold is deducted.
default_filters: Use the agreed valid-order and recognized-revenue policy.
caveats: Gross profit requires a cost field; revenue or price alone is not profit.
Define whether shipping, discounts, tax, and refunds affect the selected margin.

name: Valid Order Count
description: Distinct count of orders that satisfy the selected valid-order policy.
default_filters: Exclude cancelled or test orders when status data is available.
caveats: Do not count line-item rows as separate orders.

name: Purchasing Customers
description: Distinct customers with at least one valid purchase in the analysis period.
caveats: Guest users require a stable identity rule.

name: Average Order Value
description: Average paid revenue per distinct valid order.
default_population: Valid paid orders in the analysis period.
denominator_policy: Use the distinct valid orders represented by the paid-amount numerator; do not count payment rows as orders.
caveats: Confirm gross versus net revenue and partial-refund handling.
source: Amplitude revenue metrics and common commerce reporting practice

name: Delivery Rate
description: Share of eligible orders that reached the defined delivered or completed status.
default_population: All eligible orders created in the analysis period.
denominator_policy: Use all distinct eligible orders before applying the delivered-status numerator filter; preserve orders without payment or delivery-detail matches.
caveats: The delivered-status set must be defined by the project or user.
Recent order cohorts may not have had enough time to reach delivery.

name: Payment Method Amount Share
description: Share of eligible paid amount contributed by a selected payment method.
default_population: All eligible payment rows associated with valid paid orders.
denominator_policy: Use paid amount across all payment methods in the same eligible population; apply the payment-type filter only to the numerator.
default_filters: Include payment rows associated with valid paid orders.
caveats: Do not describe payment amount share as order share or customer share.

name: Multi-payment Order Rate
description: Share of eligible orders with more than one payment record.
default_population: Valid orders with at least one payment row.
denominator_policy: Use distinct eligible order_id values with payment rows; first count payment rows by order_id, then filter the numerator to orders with more than one row.
default_filters: Include payment rows associated with valid paid orders.
caveats: Multiple payment rows may represent split methods or installments; confirm the dataset meaning before interpreting customer behavior.
Do not divide payment-row counts by payment-row counts when reporting an order rate.

name: Purchase Conversion Rate
description: Share of eligible visitors or users who completed a valid purchase.
default_filters: Use the same eligibility window for numerator and denominator.
caveats: Session conversion and user conversion are different metrics.
source: Amplitude funnel metrics and Google Analytics ecommerce metrics

name: Refund Rate
description: Share of paid orders or paid amount that was refunded, using an explicitly selected denominator.
default_filters: Use paid orders as the denominator.
caveats: Order refund rate and revenue refund rate must not be mixed.

name: New Purchasing Customers
description: Customers whose first valid payment falls inside the analysis period.
default_filters: Determine first purchase over all available customer history.
caveats: A truncated history can misclassify returning customers as new.

name: Repeat Purchase Rate
description: Share of eligible purchasing customers who made another valid purchase in the selected window.
default_filters: Use customers with a complete observation window in the denominator.
caveats: The return window and cohort entry event must be explicit.

name: D14 Repeat Purchase Rate
description: Share of new purchasing customers who make another valid purchase within 14 days after their first payment.
default_filters: Exclude cohorts that have not completed a 14-day observation window.
caveats: Specify whether day 0 and exactly day 14 are inclusive.
